The site is Grain & Silver Darkroom Co-op — Equipment & Chemistry Helpdesk, a support-helpdesk web application for Community darkroom maintenance and supply requests.

Owner brief: "Our members-only analogue photography darkroom needs a maintenance ticketing tool. Photographers should be able to report equipment malfunctions like faulty enlarger timers, request chemical replenishment like fixer or developer, and track ticket status by reference code. Submitted tickets must persist on the server so darkroom managers can review open issues."

Locale & copy conventions (en-GB): Use £ prices, British English spelling, day-month dates and .co.uk-style invented domains. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-08/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Grain & Silver Darkroom Co-op — Equipment & Chemistry Helpdesk: the page for community darkroom maintenance and supply requests, in a dark, low-glare palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #09090b (dr-bg), #18181b (dr-surface), #27272a (dr-card), #3f3f46 (dr-border), #f59e0b (dr-amber), #f4f4f5 (dr-text), #a1a1aa (dr-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 8px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--dr-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: a ticket reference shown once and never recoverable again; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

STEP 1 OF 4 (LIGHT MODE) — INITIAL OVERVIEW & READY WORKSPACE:

Render the initial landing state of Grain & Silver Darkroom Co-op — Equipment & Chemistry Helpdesk as a visitor first meets it on the primary workspace. Top-to-bottom structure: a brand header, then a navigation bar, then a main content area, then a content section, then the working form, then a footer.

Show the active overview/dashboard/ledger/catalogue surface populated with realistic, internally consistent records and totals, alongside the ready-to-use interactive form with visible labels for every control ("Photographer name", "Equipment or station name", "Issue category", "Urgency level", "Fault description").

User journey context: Browse currently active maintenance tickets and chemical status announcements. Open the ticket submission form, select issue category, describe the problem, and submit. Receive a ticket tracking number and reload the page to inspect the stored ticket status.

Include editorial photography where appropriate to the subject, a concise social-proof or status summary row, and the complete site footer.
